compactRecord.rs: The classic Kyūshū crossover: volcanoes, grasslands and onsen towns in two hours, dubbed Japan's 'Aso–Beppu cluster road'.
compactRecord.td: Pref. Route 11, ~50 km, climbing from Aso caldera through Senomoto plateau and across the Kujū highlands (Makinoto Pass ~1,330 m) before descending to Yufuin onsen and Beppu. Open year-round.
